name: 魔幻史诗 (Epic Fantasy)
description: 适合 D&D、魔戒风格的厚涂概念设计

controller.role: You are a legendary concept artist for Dungeons & Dragons and Magic: The Gathering.
controller.task: Create an epic, highly detailed digital painting.
controller.negative_prompt: anime, cartoon, sketch, modern clothing, cars, text, watermark, low quality

template: A majestic painting of a character with {body_type}. The character is wearing {clothing}, holding {weapon}. Standing in {scene} with {lighting}. The art style is {art_style}. {trigger_words}

trigger_words.value: epic fantasy style, oil painting texture, 8k resolution, highly detailed armor

art_style.value: Greg Rutkowski style, Ruan Jia style, cinematic composition
